title: dodag.py: _lowest_rank reset defeats MaxRankIncrease protection
description: Line 244: When all parents become non-admissible, _lowest_rank is reset to INFINITE_RANK. This defeats RFC 6550 MaxRankIncrease protection. When parents return, _admissible() bypasses the rank bound check (since _lowest_rank >= INFINITE_RANK), allowing rank to jump arbitrarily within the same DODAG version. The _lowest_rank should NOT be reset when losing parents - only when changing DODAG versions (already handled in _adopt_version). This can cause routing loops and count-to-infinity.
